title: Pase lo que pase: construcciones reduplicativas y concesión universal
goal: Master reduplicative relative subjunctive clauses ('hagas lo que hagas', 'venga quien venga') to convey universal concession and unwavering resolve.

sections.title: Unit 8: Concession & Counter-Argument — Lesson 5
body: Welcome to lesson 5 of Unit 8 (Concession & Counter-Argument). Mastering concessive nuances is fundamental for advanced debate, academic writing, and diplomatic discourse in Spanish.
In this lesson, we examine pase lo que pase: construcciones reduplicativas y concesión universal, calibrating indicative vs. subjunctive triggers to construct persuasive counter-arguments.

items: Master reduplicative relative subjunctive clauses ('hagas lo que hagas', 'venga quien venga') to convey universal concession and unwavering resolve.
Incorporate upper-intermediate debate lexicon (irrevocable, la determinación).
